definitions.explanation: The state of not having paid taxes, fees, premiums, or other required payments by the due date. A formal/administrative term.

examples.japanese: ⟦{税金|ぜいきん}→税金：03308_zeikin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{未納|みのう}になっている。
⟦{保険料|ほけんりょう}→保険料：11058_hokenryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{未納|みのう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{保障|ほしょう}→保障：03719_hoshou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{受|う}けられなく→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If non-payment of insurance premiums continues, you won't be able to receive coverage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{未納|みのう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧3か{月|げつ}⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧、⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦{解除|かいじょ}→解除：05762_kaijo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If rent remains unpaid for more than three months, the lease may be terminated.

notes: Part of the ⟦{未|み}→未〜：00277_mi⟧～ (not yet) prefix pattern: {未納|みのう} (not yet paid), {未払|みはら}い (unpaid), {未着|みちゃく} (not yet arrived). Common collocations: ⟦{税金|ぜいきん}→税金：03308_zeikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{未納|みのう} (unpaid taxes), {未納分|みのうぶん} (unpaid portion), {未納者|みのうしゃ} (non-payer). Distinguished from ⟦{滞納|たいのう}→滞納：09323_tainou⟧ (delinquent payment) — {未納|みのう} is neutral and simply means 'not yet paid,' while ⟦{滞納|たいのう}→滞納：09323_tainou⟧ implies willful non-payment or default.
